archetypeNotes: Enchantress / shrines with enchantment recursion and pillow-fort. 1 tutor, 0 fast mana, 5 utility lands.
curatorRationale: Focused casual: coherent and redundant on theme, but thin optimisation markers. Wins by grinding inevitability rather than a compact reliable plan. Supplies enchantress and a slow-but-resilient shape.
